subject: English
passage: In retrospect, one of the lessons of the 1986 Chernobyl disaster is that nuclear accidents are influenced by many factors, not the least of which is the complex interactions between reactor design flaws and human operational errors. ______ rather than just focusing on reactor technology, efforts to improve nuclear safety have begun to consider comprehensive human factors engineering, the complete integration of psychological and social elements in nuclear facility operations.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation: Choice D is the best answer. "Accordingly" logically signals that this sentence states a result or consequence of the previous information about the 1986 Chernobyl disaster. Taking into account an important lesson of the disaster (that nuclear accidents involve complex interactions between reactor design and human operational errors), safety efforts have begun to consider comprehensive human factors engineering instead of just reactor technology.
